body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented its DVD Flash hybrid camcorder 'VM-DX10' during KES 2007, which adopts 4GB built-in memory and 2.7-inch touch panel LCD screen. The VM-DX10 supports 3D Noise Reduction Filter technology allowing it to produce realistic, vivid images, Hyper Image Stabilizer feature and quick start function. It is expected to be available in Korea market in November, and suggested price is below 700,000(KRW).
